problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A⇒B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-3}} |

feedback.problem: If $A$ is true and $B$ is false, then $A⇒B$ is{{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
The statement $A⇒B$ is true *unless* $A$ is true and $B$ is false. 

So, when $A=\text{T}$ and $B=\text{F},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(A⇒B) & ≡(\text{T}⇒\text{F}) \\  & ≡\text{F}.\end{aligned}
$$

The complete truth table for $A⇒B$ is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A⇒B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
